type.name: Result
type.doc: Main source of communication of operation success.

member.name: error
member.doc: contains a human readable error message.

type.name: DeviceExtensionHeader
type.doc: Opaque struct, representing device extension header. Used in extension development.

member.name: opaque
member.doc: defines opaque member. In must not be changed directly outside extension development.

type.name: InstanceExtensionHeader
type.doc: Opaque struct, representing instance extension header. Used in extension development.

member.name: opaque
member.doc: defines opaque member. It must not be changed directly outside extension development.

type.name: AdapterDesc
type.doc: Adapter description. Describes hardware driver identificators as well as memory limits.

member.name: description
member.doc: Adapter description. Contains name of the graphics adapter.

member.name: vendor_id
member.doc: denotes Vendor ID. Can be used to find the correct adapter.

member.name: device_id
member.doc: denotes Device ID. Together with {::vendor_id} uniquely identifies the device.

member.name: dedicated_video_memory
member.doc: measures dedicated video memory in bytes. Used for device local memory type.

member.name: shared_system_memory
member.doc: measures memory that is shared with CPU in bytes. Used for upload and readback.

member.name: adapter_id
member.doc: denotes adapter unique ID (LUID). Can be used to find the correct adapter.

member.name: adapter_uuid
member.doc: stores UUID of the adapter, used only with Vulkan API on systems with no LUID.

member.name: flags
member.doc: Adapter flags. Describe the adapter kind.
